panels.name: Shared vertical front louver surround ahead of both front wheels
panels.orientation: Large 2 appears on both sides: shared source. Driver-side digit upright; passenger-side digit reversed/inverted. An asymmetric letter/axis check is needed to distinguish reflection from rotation exactly. Separate small fins have separate UV pieces.

panels.name: Rear wing underside and wrapped rear lip
panels.orientation: Underside uses 004, including the orange lip visible above. Arrows point toward driver/left across span when viewed from rear; exact top/bottom edge correspondence remains uncalibrated.

panels.name: Rear bumper outer shell
panels.orientation: +x travels from driver side toward passenger side around rear; +y goes down the rear face. Corners distort.

panels.name: Shared front brake-duct outer surround, both sides
panels.orientation: The same 009 appears on both front openings. Driver-side digits upright; passenger-side digits rotated 180 degrees. +x points outward toward each front wheel. Independent left/right graphics are impossible on these shared texels.

panels.name: Shared front brake-duct inner return
panels.orientation: 020 appears on the vertical inner return behind the 009 surround in both openings. Duct mesh stays separate. Complete interior extent and rotation need more sampling.

panels.name: Rear bumper center inset
panels.orientation: 021 reads upright from behind; +x goes toward passenger/right, +y down. The tow strap and circular tow opening remain separate.

panels.name: Rear wing top
panels.orientation: +x runs passenger/right to driver/left across wing; digits upside down from rear, so +y runs toward vehicle front on the visible upper face.

panels.name: Rear deck trailing lip, upper face
panels.orientation: 040 is the orange horizontal ledge above the tail lamp/badge strip; distinct from the elevated rear wing. +x points toward driver/left; digits upside down when viewed from rear.

panels.name: Rear deck trailing lip, rear-facing face
panels.orientation: 041 is the narrow face just above PORSCHE. +x points toward driver/left; lettering upside down from rear. This is not the wing underside.

panels.name: Driver/left wing outer endplate
panels.orientation: 044 upright from outside driver side; +x points toward rear, +y down.

panels.name: Passenger/right wing outer endplate
panels.orientation: 045 upright from outside passenger side; +x points toward front, +y down. Do not copy driver text by reflection.

panels.name: Passenger/right wing inner endplate
panels.orientation: 063 upright on inner face. Exact fore/aft arrow direction is not readable in these views.

panels.name: Driver/left wing inner endplate
panels.orientation: 064 upright on inner face. Exact fore/aft arrow direction is not readable in this view.

panels.name: Passenger mirror outer shell
panels.orientation: 078 on outer/top shell, locally upright from passenger side; arrows go toward vehicle front. Underside black insert and stalk are separate; far face not yet observed.

panels.name: Passenger side intake outer surround
panels.orientation: 080 upright from passenger side; +x points rearward, +y down. This differs from the upside-down passenger main-body texture.

panels.name: Passenger main body: fender, door, sill, pillars and rear quarter
panels.orientation: +x front to rear; +y up the physical side. Rotate upright text 180 degrees relative to the driver side, never reflect lettering.

panels.name: Front bumper main skin
panels.orientation: +y goes from passenger/right across nose toward driver/left. At the central face +x goes upward toward hood. Lamp joins pending.

panels.name: Front lower splitter
panels.orientation: Narrow left-edge strip. Cells 0,9 and 0,10 visible across nose; +y goes toward driver/left. Lip thickness and returns pending.

panels.name: Passenger door handle outer face
panels.orientation: 120 upright from passenger side. The handle recess is on main body; the physical handle face is this separate island. Text follows a curved horizontal face.

panels.name: Hood
panels.orientation: +x nose to windshield; +y passenger/right to driver/left. Front-readable upright logo rotates 90 degrees clockwise in UV.

panels.name: Exterior windshield banner
panels.orientation: Runs across car along UV y. Readable front-view artwork uses top toward +x and reading direction +y. Visible crop limits remain unmeasured.

panels.name: Roof
panels.orientation: +x windshield to rear glass; +y passenger/right to driver/left. Escape flap is a feature within this island.

panels.name: Rear deck and rear-glass painted surround
panels.orientation: +x roof to tail; +y passenger/right to driver/left. The center is not body paint; atlas components sit inside its UV opening.

panels.name: PORSCHE rear lettering texture atlas
panels.orientation: Rear letters pick up diagnostic pink from this atlas. Each glyph uses a small texture area: do not draw a body stripe through the atlas. Smaller badging lines remain unassigned.

panels.name: Driver main body: fender, door, sill, pillars and rear quarter
panels.orientation: +x front to rear; +y down the physical side. Text upright in UV reads upright in the side view.

panels.name: Driver door handle outer face
panels.orientation: 143 upside down from driver side; handle face separate from main-body recess. Use a 180-degree text rotation relative to the diagnostic.

panels.name: Driver side intake outer surround
panels.orientation: 153 upright from driver side; +x points rearward, +y down. Separate from side body.

panels.name: Driver mirror outer shell
panels.orientation: 156 locally upside down from driver side, arrows point toward rear. Underside black insert/stalk separate; far face not yet observed.
